_comment: Niv-Mizzet, Parun's CAST trigger starts the loop before the spell even resolves. Mid-turn frame (resume_at main1, land drop spent): a summoning-sick Niv-Mizzet, Parun wearing Curiosity, one Island; hand Ponder. Casting Ponder triggers Parun (draw a card, FireOnCastTriggers), that draw pings, Curiosity draws, and the loop kills from 20 while Ponder is still on the stack. Fails if the cast trigger stops drawing or the cast-trigger flush stops resolving the pings.
